en.text: On the eighth day, Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel;

zhSimplified.text: 到了第八天，摩西召了亚伦和他儿子，并以色列的众长老来，

zhTraditional.text: 到了第八天，摩西召了亞倫和他兒子，並以色列的眾長老來，

en.text: and he said to Aaron, “Take a calf from the herd for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering, without defect, and offer them before the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 对亚伦说：「你当取牛群中的一只公牛犊作赎罪祭，一只公绵羊作燔祭，都要没有残疾的，献在耶和华面前。

zhTraditional.text: 對亞倫說：「你當取牛群中的一隻公牛犢作贖罪祭，一隻公綿羊作燔祭，都要沒有殘疾的，獻在耶和華面前。

en.text: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Take a male goat for a sin offering; and a calf and a lamb, both a year old, without defect, for a burnt offering;

zhSimplified.text: 你也要对以色列人说：『你们当取一只公山羊作赎罪祭，又取一只牛犊和一只绵羊羔，都要一岁、没有残疾的，作燔祭，

zhTraditional.text: 你也要對以色列人說：『你們當取一隻公山羊作贖罪祭，又取一隻牛犢和一隻綿羊羔，都要一歲、沒有殘疾的，作燔祭，

en.text: and a bull and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before the LORD; and a meal offering mixed with oil: for today the LORD appears to you.’”

zhSimplified.text: 又取一只公牛，一只公绵羊作平安祭，献在耶和华面前，并取调油的素祭，因为今天耶和华要向你们显现。』」

zhTraditional.text: 又取一隻公牛，一隻公綿羊作平安祭，獻在耶和華面前，並取調油的素祭，因為今天耶和華要向你們顯現。』」

en.text: They brought what Moses commanded before the Tent of Meeting. All the congregation came near and stood before the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 于是他们把摩西所吩咐的，带到会幕前；全会众都近前来，站在耶和华面前。

zhTraditional.text: 於是他們把摩西所吩咐的，帶到會幕前；全會眾都近前來，站在耶和華面前。

en.text: Moses said, “This is the thing which the LORD commanded that you should do; and the LORD’s glory shall appear to you.”

zhSimplified.text: 摩西说：「这是耶和华吩咐你们所当行的；耶和华的荣光就要向你们显现。」

zhTraditional.text: 摩西說：「這是耶和華吩咐你們所當行的；耶和華的榮光就要向你們顯現。」

en.text: Moses said to Aaron, “Draw near to the altar, and offer your sin offering, and your burnt offering, and make atonement for yourself, and for the people; and offer the offering of the people, and make atonement for them, as the LORD commanded.”

zhSimplified.text: 摩西对亚伦说：「你就近坛前，献你的赎罪祭和燔祭，为自己与百姓赎罪，又献上百姓的供物，为他们赎罪，都照耶和华所吩咐的。」

zhTraditional.text: 摩西對亞倫說：「你就近壇前，獻你的贖罪祭和燔祭，為自己與百姓贖罪，又獻上百姓的供物，為他們贖罪，都照耶和華所吩咐的。」

en.text: So Aaron came near to the altar, and killed the calf of the sin offering, which was for himself.

zhSimplified.text: 于是，亚伦就近坛前，宰了为自己作赎罪祭的牛犊。

zhTraditional.text: 於是，亞倫就近壇前，宰了為自己作贖罪祭的牛犢。

en.text: The sons of Aaron presented the blood to him; and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put it on the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the base of the altar;

zhSimplified.text: 亚伦的儿子把血奉给他，他就把指头蘸在血中，抹在坛的四角上，又把血倒在坛脚那里。

zhTraditional.text: 亞倫的兒子把血奉給他，他就把指頭蘸在血中，抹在壇的四角上，又把血倒在壇腳那裏。

en.text: but the fat, and the kidneys, and the cover from the liver of the sin offering, he burned upon the altar, as the LORD commanded Moses.

zhSimplified.text: 惟有赎罪祭的脂油和腰子，并肝上取的网子，都烧在坛上，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的；

zhTraditional.text: 惟有贖罪祭的脂油和腰子，並肝上取的網子，都燒在壇上，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的；

en.text: The meat and the skin he burned with fire outside the camp.

zhSimplified.text: 又用火将肉和皮烧在营外。

zhTraditional.text: 又用火將肉和皮燒在營外。

en.text: He killed the burnt offering; and Aaron’s sons delivered the blood to him, and he sprinkled it around on the altar.

zhSimplified.text: 亚伦宰了燔祭牲，他儿子把血递给他，他就洒在坛的周围，

zhTraditional.text: 亞倫宰了燔祭牲，他兒子把血遞給他，他就灑在壇的周圍，

en.text: They delivered the burnt offering to him, piece by piece, and the head. He burned them upon the altar.

zhSimplified.text: 又把燔祭一块一块地、连头递给他，他都烧在坛上；

zhTraditional.text: 又把燔祭一塊一塊地、連頭遞給他，他都燒在壇上；

en.text: He washed the innards and the legs, and burned them on the burnt offering on the altar.

zhSimplified.text: 又洗了脏腑和腿，烧在坛上的燔祭上。

zhTraditional.text: 又洗了臟腑和腿，燒在壇上的燔祭上。

en.text: He presented the people’s offering, and took the goat of the sin offering which was for the people, and killed it, and offered it for sin, like the first.

zhSimplified.text: 他奉上百姓的供物，把那给百姓作赎罪祭的公山羊宰了，为罪献上，和先献的一样；

zhTraditional.text: 他奉上百姓的供物，把那給百姓作贖罪祭的公山羊宰了，為罪獻上，和先獻的一樣；

en.text: He presented the burnt offering, and offered it according to the ordinance.

zhSimplified.text: 也奉上燔祭，照例而献。

zhTraditional.text: 也奉上燔祭，照例而獻。

en.text: He presented the meal offering, and filled his hand from there, and burned it upon the altar, in addition to the burnt offering of the morning.

zhSimplified.text: 他又奉上素祭，从其中取一满把，烧在坛上；这是在早晨的燔祭以外。

zhTraditional.text: 他又奉上素祭，從其中取一滿把，燒在壇上；這是在早晨的燔祭以外。

en.text: He also killed the bull and the ram, the sacrifice of peace offerings, which was for the people. Aaron’s sons delivered to him the blood, which he sprinkled around on the altar;

zhSimplified.text: 亚伦宰了那给百姓作平安祭的公牛和公绵羊。他儿子把血递给他，他就洒在坛的周围；

zhTraditional.text: 亞倫宰了那給百姓作平安祭的公牛和公綿羊。他兒子把血遞給他，他就灑在壇的周圍；

en.text: and the fat of the bull and of the ram, the fat tail, and that which covers the innards, and the kidneys, and the cover of the liver;

zhSimplified.text: 又把公牛和公绵羊的脂油、肥尾巴，并盖脏的脂油与腰子，和肝上的网子，都递给他；

zhTraditional.text: 又把公牛和公綿羊的脂油、肥尾巴，並蓋臟的脂油與腰子，和肝上的網子，都遞給他；

en.text: and they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burned the fat on the altar.

zhSimplified.text: 把脂油放在胸上，他就把脂油烧在坛上。

zhTraditional.text: 把脂油放在胸上，他就把脂油燒在壇上。

en.text: Aaron waved the breasts and the right thigh for a wave offering before the LORD, as Moses commanded.

zhSimplified.text: 胸和右腿，亚伦当作摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇，都是照摩西所吩咐的。

zhTraditional.text: 胸和右腿，亞倫當作搖祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖，都是照摩西所吩咐的。

en.text: Aaron lifted up his hands toward the people, and blessed them; and he came down from offering the sin offering, and the burnt offering, and the peace offerings.

zhSimplified.text: 亚伦向百姓举手，为他们祝福。他献了赎罪祭、燔祭、平安祭就下来了。

zhTraditional.text: 亞倫向百姓舉手，為他們祝福。他獻了贖罪祭、燔祭、平安祭就下來了。

en.text: Moses and Aaron went into the Tent of Meeting, and came out, and blessed the people; and the LORD’s glory appeared to all the people.

zhSimplified.text: 摩西、亚伦进入会幕，又出来为百姓祝福，耶和华的荣光就向众民显现。

zhTraditional.text: 摩西、亞倫進入會幕，又出來為百姓祝福，耶和華的榮光就向眾民顯現。

en.text: Fire came out from before the LORD, and consumed the burnt offering and the fat upon the altar. When all the people saw it, they shouted, and fell on their faces.

zhSimplified.text: 有火从耶和华面前出来，在坛上烧尽燔祭和脂油；众民一见，就都欢呼，俯伏在地。

zhTraditional.text: 有火從耶和華面前出來，在壇上燒盡燔祭和脂油；眾民一見，就都歡呼，俯伏在地。
